policy: Exact commits resolved with 'git ls-remote' and shallow clones on 2026-09-27. Inference has NOT been run for any backend yet: the reconnaissance sandbox had no GPU and its network policy blocked huggingface.co, ml-site.cdn-apple.com and download.pytorch.org. 'gpu_smoke_test' records that honestly.

repositories.name: moge
repositories.model_license: UNVERIFIED — HF model cards unreachable from the sandbox; treated as non-commercial until verified
repositories.windows: plausible: v2 inference path needs torch, utils3d_moge, pipeline (pure Python); flex_gemm is only needed for v3 sparse modules
repositories.vram: ViT-S/ViT-L single image well under 8 GB (to be measured)
repositories.integration: backend 'moge_rgbd' via workers/moge_worker.py in runtime 'photo-cu128' (experimental); newly added to the matrix during reconnaissance; 2.0.0-rc7: MoGe-3 normals and several passes (photo, mirror, coarser level), MoGe-3 ViT-G for photos when installed

repositories.name: sharp
repositories.model_license: Apple Machine Learning Research Model License — research purposes only, non-commercial (LICENSE_MODEL)
repositories.windows: plausible: pure PyTorch prediction (CPU/CUDA/MPS); gsplat only for its own video rendering
repositories.vram: to be measured; Splatline reports ~2.5 GB checkpoint
repositories.entry_point: sharp predict -i DIR -o DIR -c sharp_2572gikvuh.pt -> <stem>.ply (OpenCV convention, sRGB SH DC)
repositories.integration: Real 3D 'the photo locked' (rc56, workers/sharp_depth_worker.py): RGBGaussianPredictor.forward(image, disparity_factor, depth=measured metric depth) - the released LearnedAlignment UNet aligns SHARP's depth to the measured one; maximum detail runs it on parts of the photo with their real principal point; research profile only; user downloads weights after accepting the Apple license

repositories.name: sapiens2
repositories.model_license: Sapiens2 License (Hugging Face: license other / sapiens2-license; not gated)
repositories.windows: plain PyTorch; only the zero-dependency backbone is vendored (workers/sapiens2_backbone.py)
repositories.entry_point: workers/human_geometry.py: Sapiens2 backbone + inference-only copies of sapiens.dense PointmapHead / SegHead (outputs checked identical to the originals on the same weights)
repositories.integration: Real 3D 'the photo locked' (rc58): people's outline (seg) and 3D shape (pointmap, canonical focal 768 converted with the photo's real lens) fused into MoGe's depth inside the people; their distance is a real-world scale cue when no face is found; 2.0.0-rc7: sapiens2-normal-1b NormalHead (workers/human_geometry.py) for people's fine relief

repositories.name: gsplat
repositories.windows: prebuilt wheels for some torch/CUDA combos at https://docs.gsplat.studio/whl; otherwise JIT compile (needs MSVC + CUDA toolkit)
repositories.integration: inside runtimes (SHARP dependency, recon3d training). The application's own preview/VR180 renderer is a numpy reference renderer.

repositories.name: splatv
repositories.windows: plain WebGL2 in Chrome / Edge; no native code
repositories.vram: the browser holds every splat of the 4D scene: the app caps a .splatv at 4 M splats (~256 MB)
repositories.entry_point: hybrid.js (sha256 c1dfe6309a0602a1e94c0858259936e9b6b0c017847c3b57a677e1c5c5f012a7): shaders, worker depth sort and the .splatv layout were adapted, not copied verbatim
repositories.gpu_smoke_test: browser test with SwiftShader (tests/integration/test_player4d.py); not yet run in a headset
repositories.integration: assets/webxr/player4d.html + player4d.js (WebXR, timeline, frame-accurate playback); .splatv written by src/twod2vr/scene4d.py (rc49)

repositories.name: depth-pro
repositories.model_license: Apple Machine Learning Research Model License (apple-amlr) - research, non-commercial
repositories.windows: pure PyTorch + timm; installed by copying src/depth_pro into the runtime (copy_package, no build)
repositories.vram: ~2 GB in fp16 at 1536 x 1536 (upstream: 0.3 s per 2.25 MP on a V100)
repositories.entry_point: depth_pro.create_model_and_transforms(DepthProConfig(checkpoint_uri=...)); model(x 1536x1536 in [-1, 1]) -> canonical inverse depth, fov_deg; depth = f_px / (W * canonical)
repositories.gpu_smoke_test: not run (no GPU in the development sandbox); API checked on CPU with random weights
repositories.integration: 2.0.0-rc7: workers/moge_worker.py precision path - second depth joined to MoGe-3 (precision.depth_ensemble) and lens check (precision.lens_choice)
